description:
Review and run one-way Windows folder sync to servers, mapped drives and UNC paths.

LibSync is a general Windows folder synchronization tool for publishing one selected source to one or more reviewed targets. Before writing, it compares source and target and shows new, changed, unchanged and orphaned files. Targets can be local folders, mapped network drives or UNC paths. Existing target files are backed up before overwrite or deletion, with each run kept separately. Profiles store repeated source and target combinations, and excluded extensions keep temporary formats out of the comparison. AutoCAD block libraries and tool palettes are a supported use case, but AutoCAD is not required.
- Offline Dutch/English user guide with chapter navigation, light/dark styling, mobile layout and print support.
- Open the installed guide through Help > User guide or F1, including from dialogs.
- Practical instructions for profiles, preview, sync, staging, orphan files, backup, restore and troubleshooting.
